 National | 4 hours ago Dengue claims 5 more lives, 1,898 hospitalised in 24 hours
 FE ONLINE DESK
 Published :
 Oct 24, 2026, 10:48 
 Five more people died of dengue and 1,898 new patients were hospitalised across the country in 24 hours until 8:00 am on Saturday.
 With the latest fatalities, the dengue death toll has risen to 376 in the country this year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), reports UNB.
 Among the deaths, two were reported in Chattogram division and one each in Dhaka South City Corporation, Khulna and Rajshahi divisions, it said.
 Since January 1 this year, a total of 121,699 dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country. Of them, 115,132 have recovered.
